name: qjs_define_property_value_str_composition
prototype: int qjs_define_property_value_str(JSContext *ctx, JSValue obj, const char *name, size_t len, JSValue value, int flags)

ownership.argument: This build inlines the wrapper. The module must call, in this order: (1) atom = JS_NewAtomLen(ctx, name, len) at 0xC294DCC (or the 3-argument core 0xC294B50); (2) the generic atom-plus-value define, which is NOT yet pinned on this build - the obvious-looking 0xC2A46F8 is the integer-key variant (it formats the key with "%lld") and must not be used for a name; (3) release the atom with 0xC2780B0 (or its inlined twin 0xC2780D4) unconditionally, including on the error path.

provenance.source: .155 keeps this as a 64-byte wrapper 0xc3c3c46 that creates an atom from the name, calls the define and releases the atom. On p67 the atom creator is 0xC294DCC/0xC294B50 and the atom release is 0xC2780B0/0xC2780D4, but no function calls both and no 40-80 byte function matches the wrapper, so the wrapper is inlined here rather than missing. The define half is the one open piece: the name-keyed define was not isolated, and the integer-key define at 0xC2A46F8 is a different function.

notes: Composition note, not an address. The three pieces are each recorded individually; this record exists so the module-side adapter can be written against the same order .155 used.
